blinding_compliance: Reviewed only the supplied V004 packet and public technical context stated therein. Did not inspect coordinator, hidden truth, scoring code, other reviewers' outputs, or web sources for this benchmark.
ai_assistance: AI assistance was used to draft and format this review from the supplied packet; no substantive judgment was delegated to another reviewer.

forbidden_at_checkpoint: Treating the current brightness readings as adequate for substantive production analysis, including control charting, process behaviour conclusions, capability indices, or fraction-out-of-spec claims.
Asserting where line brightness sits today against 350-550 cd/m2 or that the production process is inside the accepted range.
Claiming a confirmed process root cause or an achieved process improvement from the current measurement-system study data.
Using the MSA study mean of 456.18 cd/m2 as evidence that production brightness is acceptable.
permitted_at_checkpoint: Diagnosing the measurement system from the crossed gage R&R data: variance components, operator offsets, repeatability, equal-variance tests, and normality checks.
Stating that the measurement system is unacceptable because %study variation, %tolerance, and ndc fail the documented gates.
Stating that the per-unit production record remains locked and therefore control charting and capability analysis cannot be performed.
Recommending measurement-system corrective actions and a re-run of the crossed 3x10x3 gage study before downstream substantive analysis.
Reporting the computed 52.05% GRR value to the data-service gate and accepting the lock.
reviews.extra_computation_detail: The pooled-interaction robustness check, operator one-way ANOVA, Levene equal-variance test, descriptive summary, and normality tests are acceptable restricted diagnostics used to characterize why the gage fails. None are used to unlock or substitute for the unreleased process-run data, and the study mean is explicitly withheld from production inference.
allowed_alternatives: After measurement-system corrections, a re-run crossed 3x10x3 gage R&R would be valid; if %study GRR <= 30 and ndc >= 5, then control charting and capability analysis on released per-unit data would become valid.

Pooling the part-by-operator interaction would be defensible under a higher interaction p-value threshold, such as p > 0.25; here the report retained it at p = 0.146 and also showed the pooled model still fails.
Exploratory operator-bias and repeatability diagnostics are valid as root-cause direction-finding only, not as proof of a specific physical cause.

reviews.rationale: The crossed gage R&R fails the stated acceptance criteria on %study variation, %tolerance, and ndc. Therefore the only defensible substantive conclusion at this checkpoint is that the measurement system is inadequate and downstream process characterization or capability conclusions must be withheld. The report reaches exactly that conclusion, supports it with diagnostic detail, and does not overclaim or produce invented downstream numbers.
reviews.numerical_check: Checked variance-component arithmetic: sdGRR^2 + sdPart^2 = 1959.15 total variance; %study = 23.038/44.262*100 = 52.05; %tolerance = 6*23.038/200*100 = 69.11; ndc = sqrt(2)*37.794/23.038 = 2.32. Within-operator variances reproduce sdRepeat = 17.40. Raw 90-reading ANOVA was not refitted; all p-values are self-reported.
